description: List conversations from the Soclo app’s Inbox: platform, contact, last message preview and unread count. Needs read:inbox. Free; changes nothing. Optionally filter by accountId, platform or status.

accountId.description: Limit to one connected account, from soclo_accounts_list.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call.

status.description: Limit to one conversation status, if the app supports it.

name: soclo_inbox_list
title: List your inbox conversations
